intent.proves: An enabled scheduled task runs the user segment search calculation add-in.
intent.scope: ScheduledTask rows with the UserSmartSearchScheduledTaskAddIn add-in type

bindings.reason: Needs a filter on the add-in type and enabled state; mcp-count has no filter.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ScheduledTask WHERE TaskEnabled = 1 AND TaskAddInTypeName LIKE 'Dynamicweb.Security.UserManagement.SmartSearchProviders.UserSmartSearchScheduledTaskAddIn%'
